verdict.rationale: Jules generates a plan for each submitted task, and the plan can be reviewed and approved before any code changes are made. The API also supports sessions that require explicit plan approval, which gives a gate on scope before the agent modifies code. missing for 10: an explicit spec/contract artifact (e.g. acceptance criteria) separate from the plan, role-based approval by a lead for tasks other people submit, and independent hands-on corroboration of the approval gate.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can approve a task's scope and contract before an agent is allowed to modify the repository
